hero.caption: Savannah grassland illuminated by dawn sunlight, west of Olifants Camp in the central Kruger Park, Limpopo province, South Africa500px provided description: Sunrise in savanna grassland. The grasses support some of the biggest herds of zebra, buffalo, impala, giraffes, elephants and wildebeest as well as the top predator, lions. This Biome constitutes some 46% of southern Africa and has 2 main seasons, namely dry and wet, which impact on the ecosystem by heavy rainfall in summer and grass fires during the dry winter. images.caption: Johnson Square was named for Robert Johnson, a Governor of South Carolina who befriended the colonists when Georgia was first settled. The Declaration of Independence was read aloud here to an enthusiastic audience on August 10, 1776. The central monument is erected to the US Revolutionary War hero Nathanael Greene. Greene's remains, along with the remains of his son, are interred under the monument.
